The 皖赣支干线 (Anqing-Poyang) branch has cleared its regulatory ladder — NDRC project approval 发改能源〔2023〕1546号 (cited in both MEE 批复 documents), first EIA public disclosure naming the branch specifically 2024-05-14 (pipechina.com.cn/front/tzgg/2001801.html: 169.5km, D1016mm, 10MPa, 43.1亿方/年设计年输量), and final EIA approval 环审〔2025〕83号 dated 2025-09-24 (mee.gov.cn/.../t20250925_1128127.html, same specs). Under China's mandatory '三同时' rule (environmental facilities built simultaneously with the main project, restated explicitly in both MEE 批复 documents), formal main-line construction on 皖赣支干线 specifically could not have legally begun before its own EIA approval cleared on 2025-09-24 — under a year before this research date (2026-09-09). Given the branch is fully permitted but I can find no confirmed physical construction start specific to it, 'proposed' remains the best-supported status: PipeChina (国家管网, via its 西气东输分公司) is the builder/owner in both documents; Sinopec does not appear anywhere in connection with this branch.

resolutions.researcher_notes: STAGED AT 12 MPa, BUT THE SYSTEM DOES NOT HAVE ONE UNIFORM MAINLINE PRESSURE — read the __VALIDITY__ before pasting. Whole-line evidence: 陆家嘴金融网 carrying 西部管道's own 西二线投产十周年 feature describes the line as '管材X80高钢级、管径1219毫米大口径，12兆帕高压力，年输气量300亿立方米，主要包括1条干线和8条支干线' and calls 12兆帕 '长输管道压力全球第一'; 人民网上海 2021 calls WEP2 China's '压力最高' gas pipeline without giving the number. Section evidence: MEE 环验〔2015〕227号 (西段, 霍尔果斯→靖边) '干线管径为1219毫米、设计压力12兆帕' — but MEE 环验〔2016〕100号 (东段, 麟游→广州从化) gives '干线管径1219毫米，设计压力10兆帕'. So 12 MPa is the design pressure of the WESTERN mainline and the headline figure for the system; the EASTERN mainline is 10 MPa, as are all 支干线/联络线 in both acceptance letters. Tier is medium, independent false: the two refs are not independent confirmations of one number — one is a whole-line statement, one a section document, and the second whole-line source (人民网) omits the figure. Rejected: ncsti.gov.cn's '压力10~12兆帕' line, whose surrounding block (工程为1干1支，总长度为4661千米…与西二线并行约3000千米) is internally self-contradictory and actually describes another line. Searched for a PipeChina/CNPC whole-line design-pressure statement; cnpc.com.cn returns 412 (WAF) and has no Wayback capture of its 西气东输 page. [QC] tier medium -> high (one validated ref is sufficient, rule 4).

resolutions.researcher_notes: ProposalYear 2007. 求是网 2024-10-21 ('西气东输二线于2007年启动，2011年投入运营') and China Daily 2022-01-04 ('2007年，西气东输二线工程正式启动，2011年投入运营') both state it while naming the line, but their wording is near-identical, so they are treated as ONE origin — tier medium, independent false, not high. Independent CONTEMPORANEOUS corroboration exists and is described here rather than cited, because it fails the name test: the Wayback capture of Xinhua English 2007-04-06 'CNPC plans to build longest LNG pipeline' (https://web.archive.org/web/20121008124425/http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2007-04/06/content_5942133.htm) reports the plan four months into 2007 with this project's unmistakable specs — CNPC-operated, from northwest Xinjiang to Guangzhou, gas from Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan, 'annual capacity of 30 billion cubic meters', construction 'planned to start next year' — but it calls the project only 'China's longest natural gas pipeline' and uses 'West-East pipeline' for WEP1, so it never names THIS row (proposal-stage figures of 6,500 km / 80亿元 also differ from as-built, as expected at that stage). PetroChina's 2007 annual report (March 2008) lists 西气东输二线 among the 2008 capex projects, confirming the project was a funded plan by end-2007. Downstream anchors: MEE records the EIA approval as 环审〔2008〕18号 (January 2008) for the west section and 环审〔2008〕318号 (August 2008) for the east, and construction began 2008-02 — both consistent with a 2007 proposal. ProposalMonth left BLANK: no source states a month, and the April 2007 Xinhua dateline is the earliest located public announcement, not a stated proposal date. [QC] tier medium -> high (one validated ref is sufficient, rule 4).

resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTINGENT FILL -- read the contingency before pasting. The SSE 2023 bond prospectus states a single design pressure for the Jiangxi Phase I network's trunk lines: '一期工程 ... 干线全长 860 公里（不含支线）... 管道设计压力为 6.3 兆帕'. Corroborated independently by the 2024-12-31 江西省能源局 approval, which specifies 6.3 MPa for the section of the new interconnection that ties into the PHASE I network ('第二段 ... 设计压力6.3兆帕') versus 10 MPa for the WEP2 side ('第一段 ... 设计压力10兆帕') -- i.e. 6.3 MPa is the Phase I network's operating grade at exactly this location (高安市大城镇). Under the sheet's own current label ('West-East Gas Pipeline 2') the answer would be 10.0 MPa -- every Jiangxi West-East asset in PipeChina's 2026 facility workbook is 10.0 MPa. This row's own sheet naming (segment_name='Yujiang-Jingdezhen Gas Pipeline', OtherLanguageAlternativePipelineNames='西气东输二线余景线（余江-景德镇）') asserts it is a WEP2 branch codenamed 余景线 (Phase II / WEP2-fed by GEM's own naming). THREE independent, directly-read primary sources complicate that, and two of them (the DRC plan and the CCXI report) are independent of each other yet AGREE on the same conclusion: (1) the Jiangxi DRC provincial gas plan (赣发改规划〔2014〕325号) states WEP2's own Jiangxi footprint explicitly EXCLUDES Jingdezhen prefecture as of 2011-2014, and separately identifies the province's actual Jingdezhen-serving Phase I trunk as '九江-景德镇' (Jiujiang-Jingdezhen, fed by 川气东送/Sichuan-East Gas) -- a different route/source entirely from this row's Yujiang-Jingdezhen naming; (2) the 2022 CCXI credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团, an authoritative and RECENT source, states in its own footnote that the Phase I network (54%-JV-operated, 川气东送-fed, NOT WEP2) covers BOTH of this row's endpoints -- Jingdezhen AND Yingtan (which administers Yujiang county) -- while Phase II (100%-subsidiary-operated) is the WEP2-fed network; (3) the Phase I network company's own baike.baidu.com profile describes itself as currently mainly fed by 川气东送, not WEP2, and runs a dedicated Jingdezhen management office consistent with owning Jingdezhen-area gas infrastructure generally. On balance, the CCXI report's direct, recent, footnoted naming of BOTH this row's endpoints under Phase I is the single strongest piece of evidence found, and tips the weight of evidence toward Phase I/川气东送 over WEP2 -- but no source names '余景线' or '余江-景德镇' directly, so this stays a flagged concern, not a value change. Grepped all 44 batches/*.json payloads for 高安 and 新余 before filing: only batches/P4778.json (row 2667) and batches/P5861.json (row 3325) carry the 高安-新余 pair. P4793 is 高安-余江 (Gao'an-YUJIANG -- a genuinely different line; the company shorthand 高余线 means 高安-余江, NOT 高安-新余, per shards/P4793.json), P4794 is 九江-高安, P5859 is 高安-丰城. resolutions.researcher_notes:
BATCH-WIDE SENTINEL (the Phase I/II operator-owner question I was asked to settle for the whole cohort, filed from this row because it is the row that owed both an Owner ref and an Operator second source). Three parts, as asked: (i) what the authoritative mapping actually is, (ii) which rows in this run carry a sheet phase label or an owner/operator attribution the sources contradict, (iii) what the merge should do. All quotations below are from bodies I fetched and extracted myself this pass; I did not re-research any other row's physical specs, only read their shards.

=== (i) THE AUTHORITATIVE MAPPING ===
CCXI 2022 (qixin PDF), footnote 1, verbatim: '目前，江西省共有两家省级天然气长输管道运营商，分别为江西省天然气管道有限公司（以下简称"天然气管道公司"）和江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司（以下简称"管道分公司"），其中天然气管道公司负责投资建设及运营承接川气东送气源的一期管网，为公司控股 54%股权的一级子公司；管道分公司承接西气东输二线气源的二期管网工程。'
SSE 242696 (2025-04-03), footnote 5, verbatim: '天然气集团持有天然气管道公司 54%的股权，剩余 46%股权由国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司（原"中国石化管道储运有限公司"）持有。'
So the mapping is, exactly:
  PHASE I (一期管网) -- gas source 川气东送 -- network company 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Co., Ltd.), owned 54% 江西省天然气集团有限公司 / 46% 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司; day-to-day operations run through its 运营分公司 (jxsggzy 2019-10-28).
  PHASE II (二期管网) -- gas source 西气东输二线 -- built and run by 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司, a BRANCH of the group, i.e. 100% group, no PipeChina equity.
Two corrections to RELAUNCH_NOTES item 2 that the primary documents force, both verified rather than carried:
  (a) The 46% holder is the PipeChina SUBSIDIARY 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司 (ex-中国石化管道储运有限公司), NEVER the parent 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司. Item 2 says so; the sheet does not.
  (b) The Phase II entity's own name is unstable IN THE PRIMARY SOURCES, and a merge that assumes one canonical string will mis-key rows. The same 管道分公司 is let out under four different parents across four tenders I read: 江西省天然气管道有限公司管道分公司 (2020-04, section 1.2), 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司 (2020-04, contact block -- the SAME document), 江西省天然气（赣投气通）控股有限公司管道分公司 (2017-12), and, separately, 江西省天然气投资有限公司 letting a 二期 procurement outright (2016-11). The 2020-04 document naming two different parents for one branch company in one notice is the proof that this is the sources' confusion, not the sheet's.

=== (ii) WHAT THE PHASE TEST DOES TO THIS RUN ===
The rule I applied is RELAUNCH_NOTES item 9 / the P4791 finding, and it is binding: the phase is whatever the SOURCES' own wording says, never the sheet's phase label and never the segment_name string. CCXI's two prefecture/county footnotes are the usable test where no segment-naming source exists:
  fn2 (PHASE I counties): '一期管网工程主要围绕鄱阳湖生态经济区规划建设，涉及南昌、九江、景德镇、新余、宜春、抚州、鹰潭、上饶等 42 个县市。'
  fn3 (PHASE II counties): '…于 2016 年初独立组建了管道分公司，负责二期管网工程剩余约 1,500 公里管线建设，涉及井冈山市、莲花县、永新县、大余县等 40 个县（市、区），总投资 62.49 亿元。'
Read together they put the Poyang-lake northern/eastern prefectures (Nanchang, Jiujiang, Jingdezhen, Xinyu, YICHUN, Fuzhou, Yingtan, Shangrao) in Phase I and the southern/western ones (Ji'an incl. Jinggangshan, Pingxiang's Lianhua, Ganzhou's Dayu) in Phase II.
Rows in this run whose recorded attribution the sources contradict:
  1. P4791 (乐平-德兴-婺源) -- sheet labels it Phase II; three segment-naming sources call it 一期 and CCXI fn2 puts both 景德镇 and 上饶 in Phase I. The finished P4791 shard establishes this and it is binding precedent, not my finding. The label is wrong.
  2. THE 46%-HOLDER DEFECT, which is the widest one in the cohort: the same fact is stated two ways across the roster and one way is wrong per SSE fn5. Staged/recorded as the PARENT 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 on P4779, P4780, P4781, P4782, P4787 (Operator), P4789 (Operator), P4792, P5863, P5887 (Operator) and on THIS row (P5862, at 100% no less); staged as the correct SUBSIDIARY 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司 on P4776, P4777, P4778, P4783, P4784, P4787 (Owner), P4791, P5859, P5864, P5865, P5886, P5887 (Owner). Eleven rows need the entity swapped, and two rows (P4787, P5887) disagree with THEMSELVES between their Owner and Operator cells.
  3. P4787 vs P4788 -- the SAME four-branch 赣州南 package, sourced from the SAME Quannan county PDF, carrying CONTRADICTORY attributions: P4787 the 54/46 Phase I JV, P4788 100% group / 管道分公司. Both cannot be right. CCXI fn3 puts 大余 (Ganzhou) in Phase II, which favours P4788's reading; the 2017-12 勘察设计 tender covering 龙南-全南段、上犹-崇义段、安远-定南段 was let by the 管道分公司, which favours it too. This is a merge decision on two rows at once, and I am not staging either row (not my rows).
  4. P4789 -- internally inconsistent in the same way (Owner 100% group, Operator the 54/46 JV). Its own phase evidence should pick one.
  5. P5863 (干洲-奉新支线, a 2023 project, sheet-labelled Phase II) -- carries the Phase I 54/46 split. If it really is a 2023 二期 build, the split is wrong; if the split is right, the phase label is. Note the pointed consequence for MY row: P5862 and P5863 are two branches to the same county, one labelled Phase I and one Phase II, with the SAME owner attribution problem in mirror image.
  6. P5862 (this row) -- its sheet Phase I label is the one case in this set that the sources CORROBORATE rather than contradict: 奉新县 is in 宜春市, CCXI fn2 lists 宜春 in Phase I, and fn3's Phase II county list contains no Yichun-prefecture county. That is why I felt able to stage Owner/Operator here off phase-level evidence at medium tier, and it is the inverse of P4791: the test can confirm a label as well as break one.

=== (iii) WHAT THE MERGE SHOULD DO ===
  A. Normalise the 46% holder to 国家管网集团东部原油储运有限公司 (PipeChina Eastern Crude Oil Storage & Transportation Co., Ltd.) on every Phase I row, tracker-wide, as a MECHANICAL fix -- it is one entity misnamed, not eleven research questions. Run entity_lookup.py first so this creates one entity, not a duplicate of the parent. Never leave a Phase I row at 'National Petroleum and Natural Gas Pipeline Network Group Co Ltd 100%', which is wrong on both the name and the share.
  B. Apply the phase test row by row, on the sources' wording, BEFORE staging any owner/operator value: segment-naming source if one exists (best), else the CCXI fn2/fn3 prefecture lists (usable, and I have quoted them so no one needs to re-fetch), else UNRESOLVED. Do not derive the phase from the sheet label or from '一期/二期' inside segment_name -- P4791 is the counter-example and P5863 may be another.
  C. Treat P4787-vs-P4788 as ONE adjudication, and P4789's internal split as a second, and P5863-vs-P5862 as a third. Three decisions, not eight cell edits.
  D. Record the Phase II entity as 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司 (the group's pipeline branch) and accept that primary sources also write it under three other parents; a name-match on the tender string alone will mis-key rows.
  E. Do not let this sentinel's mapping be used to 'complete' P5862's owner cells if the existence question in the next record resolves against the row. A correct owner on a row that should not exist is worse than a blank.
Tier high and independent: two publishers minimum on every leg -- 中诚信国际 (the CCXI report and the SSE report are ONE publisher, counted once) plus the Jiangxi public-resource trading platform (five separate notices, a different publisher and a different document class).
